macpolish.config.title: Mac Polish
macpolish.config.pointer_lock_repair.too: Keeps the pointer locked after you tab back in, so the cursor stays hidden and the menu bar and Dock can't take your input.
macpolish.config.flip_shift_scroll.toolt: Turn this on if Shift+scroll goes the opposite way to normal scrolling. This can happen if an app like Scroll Reverser sets your mouse to Classic while macOS stays on natural.
macpolish.config.held_item_framing.toolt: Mac screens are narrower than 16:9, which cuts off more of the item in your hand. This places it the way it looks on a 16:9 screen.
